newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pilecon runs on speculative play-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Pilecon runs on speculative play-dealers.

text.p: The stock and warrants of Malaysia's Pilecon Engineering Bhd were boosted on Tuesday by speculative play, dealers said.
At 0427 GMT, the stock of the engineering firm was up 54 cents to 4.62 ringgit on volume 7.6 million. The 1999 warrants rose 27 cents to 2.29 on 9.5 million shares traded.
Dealers said they did not hear of any news to account for the sudden surge.
"It seems like pure ramping. It's just syndicate play," said an institutional dealer at a Singapore-based brokerage house.
"The last time around, it rose to six-plus ringgit without news also," said another dealer.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
